steps.en: Officer screen to add and delete special vehicle numbers
steps.id: Screen officer untuk tambah dan hapus nomor kendaraan khusus
steps.why_en: The embassy screens are switched off in the code and the folder is missing.
steps.why_id: Screen embassy dimatikan di code dan foldernya tidak ada.

steps.en: The list is stored in a parameter table
steps.why_en: The rules sit in a settings file; no embassy or diplomatic table exists.
steps.why_id: Aturan ada di file setting; tabel embassy atau diplomat tidak ada.

steps.en: Specific vehicle numbers can be listed, not only suffixes
steps.id: Nomor kendaraan tertentu bisa didaftar, bukan hanya suffix
steps.why_en: Only a number pattern exists; no list of specific diplomatic numbers.
steps.why_id: Hanya ada pola nomor; tidak ada daftar nomor diplomat tertentu.

steps.en: Notices of special-suffix vehicles are recognised
steps.why_en: Recognition works, but from a settings file instead of the officer-maintained table.
steps.why_id: Pengenalan jalan, tapi dari file setting, bukan tabel kelolaan officer.

steps.en: Special-vehicle notices are processed, with DIP letters
steps.id: Notice kendaraan khusus diproses, termasuk surat DIP
steps.why_en: Only the normal reminder letters run; no embassy-based DIP letter exists.
steps.why_id: Hanya surat reminder biasa yang jalan; surat DIP berbasis embassy tidak ada.
